actions.dateNote: Execution date: every signature block on the State's signature page and Centene's is dated 9/27/2024.
actions.title: Settlement Agreement and Release between Centene Corporation (and subsidiaries incl. Sunshine State Health Plan, Envolve Pharmacy Solutions) and the State of Florida by and through its Attorney General, AHCA, OIR and DOH
actions.moneyIsPublic: The $10M is part of the $67,048,611 Settlement Amount the State recovered to release its claims against Centene (Section B.2, Section C); Section B.2 says the whole Settlement Amount is paid "as directed by AHCA" and directs $10M of it to the foundation and the balance to AHCA.
actions.officialRole: The Attorney General is a party for the State and the Releasor (Sections intro, A.9, A.13); Section H.4 has the Attorney General warrant that "she is authorized to enter into and execute this Agreement binding upon all Releasors." The direction of the $10M is stated as AHCA's (Section B.2). The Attorney General's Office block was signed by John Guard, Chief Deputy Attorney General, not by Moody personally.

quotes.text: This Settlement Agreement and Release ... is made and entered among: (i) Centene Corporation (“Centene”) and each of its current and former subsidiaries and affiliates ... and (ii) the State of Florida by and through its Attorney General; the Florida Agency for Health Care Administration (“AHCA”); the Florida Office of Insurance Regulation (“FL OIR”); and the Florida Department of Health (“FL DOH”)

WHEREAS, Hope Florida, through The Hope Florida Foundation, Inc., serves a mission that is important to the policy goals of the State of Florida; and WHEREAS, AHCA desires an expanded role for Hope Florida in the Florida Medicaid program.

the Centene Entities shall cause payments in the total aggregate amount of Sixty-Seven Million, Forty Eight Thousand, Six Hundred and Eleven Dollars ($67,048,611) (“Settlement Amount”) to be made as directed by AHCA. Specifically, AHCA directs that (i) the Centene Entities shall pay Ten Million Dollars ($10,000,000) as a one-time donation to The Hope Florida Foundation, Inc. (“Hope Florida Donation”), and (ii) the Centene Entities shall pay the balance of the Settlement Amount, Fifty-Seven Million, Forty Eight Thousand, Six Hundred and Eleven Dollars ($57,048,611), to AHCA (“Settlement Balance”).

As directed by AHCA, the Hope Florida Donation shall be paid within seven (7) days of the Execution Date by wire transfer to an account of The Hope Florida Foundation, Inc., in the manner to be directed in writing by AHCA pursuant to the Notice provisions of this Agreement.
The Attorney General, on behalf of the State, represents and warrants that she is authorized to enter into and execute this Agreement binding upon all Releasors.
THE STATE OF FLORIDA / Attorney General’s Office / By: [signature] Date: 9/27/2024 / Printed Name: John Guard / Title: Chief Deputy Attorney General

record.what: The executed agreement (DocuSign envelope ED60D886-D68E-4FD0-8D0C-6D6B696BD6EA, 16 pages, labeled EXECUTION VERSION, PDF created Sept. 27, 2024). Two public copies, same text: the first is the PDF the Florida Phoenix posted with its Apr. 9, 2025 story, the second the copy Snopes posted. The agreement itself is the record; the newsrooms only host it.
record.notFound: A DocumentCloud copy was not located in this pass; the two copies above are the same executed document. An agency-hosted copy (AHCA or OAG public-records release) would be a better citation if one is found.

actions.notShown: The agreement does not show the wire itself. Proof the $10M reached the foundation would be the foundation's own IRS Form 990 for the fiscal year that includes Sept./Oct. 2024 (its year ends June 30: the FY ending 2025-06-30 return), Part VIII contributions / Schedule B.
